faqs.q: What are the Enerpac RACL series aluminium lock nut cylinders used for?
faqs.a: Enerpac RACL series aluminium lock nut cylinders are 10,000 psi spring-return aluminium cylinders with a lock nut to hold the load. The listing carries 25 part numbers, such as RACL202 and RACL204, from 20 to 150 ton.

faqs.q: What models and part numbers are listed for the Enerpac RACL series aluminium lock nut cylinders?
faqs.a: The Enerpac RACL series aluminium lock nut cylinders are listed as 25 part numbers, for example RACL202, RACL506 and RACL15010. Together they cover rated pressure 10,000 psi, stroke 1.97" to 9.84", extended length 10.8" to 30.43", capacity 20 ton to 150 ton and retracted length 8.83" to 20.59". Quote the part number, or the capacity and size you need, and we confirm the match before supply.

faqs.q: How should I select the Enerpac RACL series aluminium lock nut cylinders for my application?
faqs.a: Choose the RACL when the load must be held mechanically after lifting. Then pick the capacity from 20 to 150 ton and the stroke, 1.97 in to 9.84 in.

faqs.q: What pressure rating do the Enerpac RACL series aluminium lock nut cylinders have?
faqs.a: The Enerpac RACL series aluminium lock nut cylinders are rated at 10,000 psi, and the stated capacity in ton is the force at that pressure. A circuit is limited by its lowest-rated component, so the pump, hose, coupler and gauge must also be rated for it.

faqs.q: Which materials are the Enerpac RACL series aluminium lock nut cylinders offered in?
faqs.a: On the Enerpac RACL series aluminium lock nut cylinders, the cylinder body is aluminium, as the item names state. Aluminium cuts the weight a great deal against steel for the same capacity, which makes the cylinder easier to carry and position, at the cost of a softer body that needs care.

faqs.q: Which standards and documents apply to the Enerpac RACL series aluminium lock nut cylinders?
faqs.a: The listing names no ISO or ASME standard for the Enerpac RACL series aluminium lock nut cylinders and holds no certificates. The maker's catalogue states the capacity and rated pressure for each part number, and a pump, hose, coupler and gauge rated to the same pressure are needed. If your site requires a test certificate, say so in the enquiry and we ask the maker what it can issue.

faqs.q: What do the Enerpac RACL series aluminium lock nut cylinders connect to?
faqs.a: The Enerpac RACL series aluminium lock nut cylinders need a pump, hose, coupler and gauge rated to the cylinder's pressure, because a circuit is limited by its lowest-rated component. Base plates and attachments for RC cylinders are on [the Enerpac cylinder accessories listing](/p/enerpac-cylinder-accessories).

faqs.q: How should the Enerpac RACL series aluminium lock nut cylinders be installed and maintained?
faqs.a: Keep the Enerpac RACL series aluminium lock nut cylinders square to the load, use a base plate or saddle where the maker lists one, and never exceed the rated pressure or the stroke. Check the plunger for scoring and the couplers for leaks, and bleed the air before loading.
